html:
/* Skill card. Position comes inline from Module:Skill. Same look as the Mount / Glider / item cards. */
/* A chain (Triple Slash) has one card per skill inside .aa-skill-set, only one is shown: the requested one
   (.aa-skill-main, always the last in the set), or the one whose icon was clicked. Every card has a small
   anchor in front of it (.aa-skill-anchor, the :target of the icon's link). The anchor is position: fixed, so
   the browser does not scroll the page when it is the target.
   All cards of a set lie on top of each other in one grid cell (the hidden ones are only invisible), so the set
   is as tall as the tallest card and the page does not jump when another skill is shown. The shown card is
   stretched to that height and keeps its Chain row at the bottom. */
.aa-skill-set {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.aa-skill-anchor {
  position: fixed;
  display: block;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-skill-set > .aa-skill {
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
  visibility: hidden;
}
.aa-skill-set > .aa-skill-main {
  visibility: visible;
}
.aa-skill-set > .aa-skill-anchor:target ~ .aa-skill-main {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.aa-skill-set > .aa-skill-anchor:target + .aa-skill {
  visibility: visible;
}
/* the card is a column so that the Chain row can sit at the bottom */
.aa-skill-set > .aa-skill {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
/* empty space where another skill of the chain has "Effect Granted" (same height as the real thing) */
.aa-skill-reserve {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.aa-skill-buffspace {
  height: 34px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
/* the free space of a stretched card goes above the Chain row, which sits at the bottom of the card */
.aa-skill-chainbox {
  margin-top: auto;
}
/* margins of a column do not collapse: the header's bottom margin and the line's top margin would add up */
.aa-skill-set > .aa-skill .aa-skill-head {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.aa-skill {
  display: flow-root;
  position: relative;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 320px;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  margin: 0 0 0.5em 0;
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: left;
}
.aa-skill-head {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.aa-skill-icon {
  line-height: 0;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
/* skill line (Songcraft ...) in the orange of the game */
.aa-skill-line {
  color: #ff9c27;
}
.aa-skill-name {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.aa-skill-sep {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 6px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5d48, transparent);
}
.aa-skill-meta {
  color: #c9c3b4;
}
.aa-skill-buffs {
  margin-top: 4px;
  line-height: 0;
}
/* green frame around the icon of an effect; hovering it opens a box with the effect */
.aa-skill-buff {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  line-height: 0;
  cursor: help;
  outline: none;
  border: 1px solid #4ec24e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(78, 194, 78, 0.6);
}
.aa-skill-bufftip {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 100%;
  z-index: 1000;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 260px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.98), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.98));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  color: #d8d2c4;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: normal;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.aa-skill-right .aa-skill-bufftip {
  left: auto;
  right: 0;
}
.aa-skill-buff:hover .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-buff:focus .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-req:hover .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-req:focus .aa-skill-bufftip {
  display: block;
}
/* an effect that needs a passive skill: always visible under the icons */
.aa-skill-req {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 5px;
  color: #ff9c27;
  cursor: help;
  outline: none;
}
.aa-skill-req img {
  display: block;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-reqnote {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  color: #ff9c27;
}
/* duration, ticks, stacks in the box of an effect */
.aa-skill-fact {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: #a8a396;
}
.aa-skill-bufftext + .aa-skill-fact {
  margin-top: 5px;
}
.aa-skill-buffname {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-skill-bufftext .aa-item-gap {
  margin-top: 0.5em;
}
/* red frame for a harmful effect (debuff) */
.aa-skill-debuff {
  border-color: #d9423a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(217, 66, 58, 0.7);
}
.aa-skill-desc {
  color: #e8e4d8;
}
.aa-skill-gap,
.aa-skill-desc .aa-item-gap {
  margin-top: 0.7em;
}

/* element (Quake, Life ...) and rank at the right of the header */
.aa-skill-tag {
  margin-left: auto;
  align-self: flex-start;
  text-align: right;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.aa-skill-elem {
  color: #f5cb65;
  font-weight: bold;
}
/* combo: icons, then the sentence of the game */
.aa-skill-combo {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.aa-skill-comboicons {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  flex: none;
  line-height: 0;
}
.aa-skill-comboicons img {
  display: block;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-ico-bad img {
  border-color: #d9423a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(217, 66, 58, 0.7);
}
.aa-skill-ico-good img {
  border-color: #4ec24e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(78, 194, 78, 0.6);
}
.aa-skill-combotext {
  color: #9acd32;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.aa-skill-arrow {
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1;
}
/* chain: the skills that follow each other, the one shown is outlined */
.aa-skill-chainlabel {
  margin: 10px 0 6px;
  text-align: center;
}
.aa-skill-chainlabel span {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #7a1f1f;
  border: 1px solid #a33;
  color: #f3d9b0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-skill-chain {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.aa-skill-chain .aa-skill-arrow {
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.aa-skill-step {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  color: #a8a396;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.aa-skill-stepicon {
  display: block;
  line-height: 0;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-current .aa-skill-stepicon {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ff9c27;
}
.aa-skill-current {
  color: #ff9c27;
}

/* Phones: a floated card gets its own line instead of squeezing the text */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .aa-skill-float {
    float: none !important;
    clear: both !important;
    margin: 0 0 0.5em 0 !important;
  }
  /* the effect box becomes a panel at the bottom of the screen (tap an icon to open) */
  .aa-skill .aa-skill-bufftip {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0.5em;
    right: 0.5em;
    top: auto;
    bottom: 0.5em;
    width: auto;
    max-height: 60vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}
